paras: Ota's mountain lizard (Cristidorsa otai) is a species of lizard in the subfamily Draconinae of the family Agamidae. The species is native to Southern Asia.
The specific name, otai, is in honor of Japanese herpetologist Hidetoshi Ota (born 1959).
Cristidorsa otai is endemic to Mizoram state in northeastern India.
Adult males of Cristidorsa otai have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 46.4 mm (1.83 in). Females are larger, at  52.2–58.7 mm (2.06–2.31 in) SVL.
